title: Expertise
subtitle: Where I can contribute to a legal or HR team.

items.title: Legal Drafting & Contract Review
items.description: Drafting and reviewing employment and corporate documents: company regulations, PKWT/PKWTT, collective labour agreements, MoU, NDA and demand letters (somasi).

items.title: Legal Research & Litigation Support
items.description: Researching regulations and case material, and preparing civil litigation documents: lawsuits, replik and duplik.

items.title: Compliance & Business Licensing
items.description: Supporting regulatory compliance in corporate, employment and environmental matters, including NPWP registration and OSS licensing.

items.title: Employee Engagement & Relations
items.description: Running engagement and people-development programmes (360° feedback, recognition, team bonding, peer counselling) for a 90-person workforce.

items.title: KPI & HR Administration
items.description: Setting up KPI monitoring and spreadsheet-based attendance, overtime and HR reporting.

items.title: Project & Event Coordination
items.description: Planning programmes across teams (timelines, budget, execution), from a 250-participant webinar to 20 community projects.
